_analysis_workers_comment: Optional. Processes for audio analysis. Omit for three quarters of the cores. Analysis is CPU-bound; measured scaling flattens past about 12 workers.
_similarity_weights_comment: Optional. Relative influence of each feature group in Find Similar. Groups are normalised first, so these are real weights rather than a side effect of how many columns a group has. Raise register if you want violin to stay away from cello; lower it if you do not care.
_database_comment: Optional. Omit this section entirely to use SQLite at db_path.
For MySQL/MariaDB, set backend to 'mysql' and fill in the rest.
